steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.

args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add a clause, click Cancel, reopen Terms & Conditions, and prove the previously added clause is absent.

steps.note: Perform the T&C modal interaction and verify that Cancel discards the unsaved clause.
Assert that the Terms & Conditions interface is present after reopening.
